Closed #26 #27 #28 #30 in one commit (eeb6946). MST divergence root-caused: detect_layer returned None for tree-only nodes, falling back to layer 0. Fix: infer layer from first tree child + explicit layer-preservation in insert_into_child. All 6 multi-leaf MST fixtures + order-independence + CAR layout (byte-equivalent) + signed-commit construction (signing bytes byte-equivalent, CIDs match, cross-impl P-256 and K-256 sig verify with TS) all green. 25 differential tests passing, full workspace clippy clean.

Pending: user needs to git push origin main + crosslink/hub. The audit-driven hardening (epic #1) is now fully exercised in CI — single-leaf, multi-leaf, order-independence, CAR framing, unsigned commit signing bytes, signed commit CIDs, cross-impl signature verification all locked in.
